summary: Over-mocking: both tests instantiate PiConversationModel directly and manually assign onHandledPiOperationFailure = { analytics.track(.handledException($0)) }, never exercising AppModel.installRuntimeCallbacks (AppModel.swift:1060), the only production site that wires model failures to analytics reporting; deleting/breaking that wiring would not fail these tests, unlike the sibling REQ-010.4.2 test which correctly invokes AppModel's installed closure.
